sn17.7:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| adhigamāyā || || Kam bhikkhave diṭṭhagatena [visallena] sallena vijjhanti taṃ sekkham appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti || ||
sn17.7:2.1: Sallanti kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasilokassetam adhavacanaṃ || || Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || Sattamaṃ || ||
